GOVERNMENT OF ANDHRA PRADESH
ABSTRACT
Andhra Pradesh Sports Policy 2024-2029 - Orders - Issued.

YOUTH ADVANCEMENT, TOURISM & CULTURE(Sps.&YS)DEPARTMENT

G.O.Ms.No.18                                Dated : 10/12/2024
                                            Read :-

G.O.Ms.No.8, YAT&C (Sports & YS) Department, Dated : 24.05.2017.

## ORDER:-

***

The Government of Andhra Pradesh recognizes sports as an effective
means of improving the health and well-being of society. Sports play a vital role
in ensuring the overall development of humanity. Sports improve quality of life,
contribute to healthier societies, and bridge cultural and social divides.
Successful sports persons and teams are symbols of national excellence and bring
positive attention to the country on the international stage. There is a need for
a new comprehensive policy framework for the promotion of sports which aims
to provide the best-in-class infrastructure facilities to the athletes and foster
sports development in the state. The policy lays due emphasis on identifying
talent early and building an active lifestyle for its citizens.

2) The Sports Policy outlines the importance of organizing competitions to
identify talent and hosting global events for increasing visibility with focus on
developing sports tourism, envisaged to cover all necessary spheres & leverage
the role of Technology and private sector participation in building a strong
sports ecosystem, strengthen the vital role of sports associations in the State.
The goal is to make sure that there is something for everyone in this new
sports. Accordingly, the Andhra Pradesh new sports policy 2024-2029 has been
designed.

3) The Government, after careful consideration and detailed examination of
several issues connected to the area of sports approve the Andhra Pradesh Sports
Policy 2024-2029, to build excellence in sports by nurturing talent, establishing
world-class infrastructure, and ensuring accessibility for all, positioning Swarna
Andhra Pradesh as the nation's sports capital and a global centre for sports talent
and innovation by 2029 as appended as Annexure to thisorder, replacing the
existing Sports Policy issued vide G.O. read above.

4) The Policy shall come into operation from the date of issue of this order
and shall remain in force for a period of 5 years or till a new Policy isformulated.

## SPORTS POLICY 2024:USHERING A NEW ERA OF SPORTS CULTURE

## PREAMBLE

Sports play a vital role in ensuring the overall development of humanity. Sports improve the quality of
life, contribute to healthier societies, and bridge cultural and social divides. Successful sportspersons
and teams are symbols of national excellence and bring positive attention to the country on the
international stage.

The Government of Andhra Pradesh recognizes sports as an effective means of improving the health
and well-being of society. There is a need for a new comprehensive policy framework for the promotion
of sports. The new Andhra Pradesh Sports Policy 2024 aims to foster a conducive ecosystem for sports
and games in the State.

The Andhra Pradesh Sports Policy 2024 aims to provide the best-in-class infrastructure facilities to
athletes and foster sports development in the state. The policy lays due emphasis on identifying talent
early and building an active lifestyle for its citizens.

## SWARNA ANDHRA SPORTS VISION 2047

Create an inclusive, accessible, and vibrant sports ecosystem in Andhra Pradesh that nurtures
talent, fosters excellence& national pride, promotes health, well-being and sustainable
development, and builds world-class infrastructure, positioning state as a global hub for sports,
commerce and international events to elevate Andhra Pradesh’s status in sports arena.

## SWARNA ANDHRA SPORTSMISSION 2029

To build excellence in sports by nurturing talent, establishing world-class infrastructure, and
ensuring accessibility for all, positioning Swarna Andhra Pradesh as the nation's sports capital
and a global centre for sports talent and innovation by 2029.

## Addressing gaps of the previous policies

The Sports Policy intends to address the policy gaps from previous policies. The policy aims to align
its endeavours with the national priorities set out in National Education Policy 2022 and National Sports
Policy 2024.Although the previous policies were comprehensive, but there remained some gaps in its
implementation and coverage.

The major gaps were identified in the areas mentioned below:



*వివిధ రంగాలలో ఉన్న సవాళ్లను వివరించే షట్కోణ రేఖాచిత్రం. మధ్యలో ఉన్న షట్కోణంలో "Inadequate resources" అని రాసి ఉంది. చుట్టూ ఉన్న షట్కోణాలలో: ఎడమవైపు పైభాగంలో "Skill Enhancement to emerging Athletes and Coaches", ఎడమవైపు దిగువన "Access to Healthcare", మధ్యలో "Schools: Alignment with the National Education Policy 2020", మధ్యలో "Inadequate use of technology", కుడివైపు పైభాగంలో "Inadequate support mechanisms for budding athletes", కుడివైపు దిగువన "Environmental sustainability in energy usage", కుడివైపు పైభాగంలో "Lack of maintenance of sports infrastructure", కుడివైపు దిగువన "Infrastructure Availability and Augmentation" అని రాసి ఉన్నాయి.*

The new Sports Policy 2024 aims to focus extensively on early identification of talent and create
effective development pathways. It focuses on mandating sports curriculum and maintaining sports
report cards in schools. It focusses on the holistic development of sports ecosystem in the state and
promotes sports promotion among citizens, students, youth, and elderly. It also focusses on promoting
active lifestyles among the workplaces. It lays a clear vision to leverage private sector participationto
augment sports infrastructure.

Private sector companies will be encouraged to earmark 10% of their CSR funds for the advancement
of sports infrastructure and the sponsorship of national and international sporting events.Corporates will
be encouraged to give project-based donations which would be eligible for tax exemptions under section
80(G). To avail 80(G) benefit a trust maybe formed within SAAP. The creation of a Sports Development
Fund under CSR initiation will ensure sustainability of funds, and this will be utilized for:

- Creating new infrastructure
- Upgrading existing infrastructure
- Providing scholarship to winners, facilitating them to participate in national and international
- events
- Provision of coaches, nutritious sustenance, sports kits, competition exposure, and sports
- equipment for the athletes,
- Conducting national and international sports competition and events.

## 10.9 Upgradation of existing infrastructure through Private partnerships

The State will adopt a renovation, modernization, and operations (RMO) approach to the upgradation
of existing infrastructure.The State will plan to lease an existing underutilized infrastructure facility for
at least 10 years. The department will plan progressive takeover of existing infrastructure through
private partnerships for efficient utilization. The private partnership will renovate, maintain, and operate
the facility.

## 10.10 Promotion of Startups in Sports Ecosystem

The state has a policy of promoting innovations and startup and a dedicated start up incubator will be
set up under the department exclusively for seeding ideas of innovation. The incubator would serve
entrepreneurs in developing innovative investment ideas in sports ecosystem and would assist in
accelerating viable solutions.

The state will explore innovative approaches such asBuild-Own-Operate, Fund of Funds, and Viability
Gap Funding to augment the role of private sector in sports infrastructure development. Another
program that could be offered for enhancing private sector participation would be to encourage them to
adopt a sport or adopt a district for promotion of sports.

## 10.12 SWARNAANDHRA Summit

Conducting international sports summits is required to attract global stakeholders and private
participation for promoting sports development.

## E SPORTS DEVELOPMENT

The state recognizes the growing popularity and potential of esports and aims to enhance its presence
and development within the state. Over the past decade, esports have gained immense popularity,
transforming into a global phenomenon with a dedicated fanbase, professional athletes, and robust
ecosystems.

The state envisions esports as a key component of the sports strategy, aiming to leverage it for youth
engagement, job creation, and technological advancement. With a growing young population and strong
technological infrastructure, the state is well-poised to integrate esports into its broader sports
framework, ensuring the sector thrives alongside traditional sports.

## Objectives

1. Promote e-sports as an integral part of the sports ecosystem of Andhra Pradesh

2. Encourage youth participation in e-sports to foster skill development and career
opportunities.Esports promotes skills like strategic thinking, teamwork, problem-solving, and
digital literacy. To enhance skill development and ensure engagement in esports, the policy
proposes to develop esports academies

3. Develop world-class infrastructure to support the growth of the e-sports sector.

4. Facilitate public-private partnerships (PPP) to build a sustainable e-sports ecosystem.

5. Ensure ethical, legal, and health-related safeguards for e-sports athletes and professionals.

6. Host national and international e-sports competitions in Andhra Pradesh

## Governance and Monitoring of E-Sports

State endeavours to ensure ethical, legal, and health-related safeguards for e-sports athletes and
professionals. Department plans to constitute an E-Sports Regulatory Authorityto ensure standards and
safeguards.

The Government of Andhra Pradesh is committed to fostering a thriving e-sports ecosystem by
addressing all facets of the industry—education, infrastructure, governance, talent development, and
innovation. By implementing this policy, the state will not only create opportunities for its youth but
also position itself as a leader in the national and global e-sports landscape. The integration of e-sports
into the broader sports framework will contribute significantly to the state‘s economic growth,
technological advancement, and international reputation in digital sports.

## MOBILISATION OF REVENUE FOR SPORTS

Allocating a sufficient budget to the Sports Department is essential & crucial for effectively
implementing sports programs with a theme of —Sports for All|| for Health & Wellness, Boosts
Community Engagement & Social Cohesion, Encourages Youth Development & Academic Success,
Supports Talent Development & National Pride, Reduces Inequality by Providing Equal Opportunities,
Improves Mental Health & Resilience.

Investing in the Sports Department and its programs is not only an investment in physical infrastructure
and activities but also in the holistic development of individuals and communities. It supports health,
cohesion, economic growth, and national identity, making it an essential allocation in a balanced budget.

## Mandatory budgetary allocation

1. Government allocate budget every year based on the requirement.

## Other avenues of funding

1. 3% Additional Cess on property taxes to be collected by Urban Local Bodies(ULBs) in the
State and to utilize the proceeds for creation of sports infrastructure in Urban areas.

## OUTCOME MONITORING

To ensure the success of this novel policy, it is essential to institute monitoring and evaluation systems
that can oversee quantitative and qualitative improvements in the Sports ecosystem. The learnings from
the monitoring and evaluation exercise can help in identifying gaps in implementation and can instruct
SAAP on areas that require interventions or policy review.

## 1. Yearly Sports Monitor Surveys

➢ SAAP will conduct an annual survey at the district level, to monitor the state of sports
infrastructure and performance of all sports academies and other facilities that fall under the
purview of this policy.The survey shall create a checklist of all projects for which money has
been sanctioned by the government and verify the status of said projects as related to their specific
milestones.

The survey shall note any gaps in funding or achievements of milestones.

## 2. State-Level Sports Promotion Report Card

➢ SAAP will be creating and releasing an annual Sports Report Card on the activities related to
sports promotion as governed by this policy.

➢ The Sports Report Card will be used to determine the distribution of funding and other
remuneration under the schemes of this policy as well as national schemes such as Khelo India.
